name: tutorial-video-director
description: Tutorial series video director: episode planning, beats and narration, SVG lecture cards at any canvas (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 4K) exported to PPTX, browser operation recording, edge-tts dubbing, subtitles and final cut rendering.

displayDescription.en: Turns a topic into a tutorial series: episode outline, beats and narration, SVG slides and PPTX at any canvas, screen recording, edge-tts dubbing, subtitles and the final cut.
displayDescription.zh: 从主题到成片：分集大纲、分镜台词、横竖屏SVG讲义卡与PPT、录屏配音字幕，直接剪出成片。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我要做一套关于 [主题] 的系列教程视频，先帮我出分集大纲和第一集分镜
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want a tutorial video series about [topic]. Start with the episode outline and the first episode's beats.

quickPrompts.en: I want a tutorial video series about [topic]. Start with the episode outline and the first episode's beats.
quickPrompts.zh: 我要做一套关于 [主题] 的系列教程视频，先帮我出分集大纲和第一集分镜

quickPrompts.en: Turn this episode's narration into SVG lecture cards and export a PPTX deck — vertical 9:16.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这集讲稿做成竖屏 SVG 讲义卡，再导出一份竖屏 PPT

quickPrompts.en: Record this browser operation, dub it with edge-tts, add subtitles and cut it into the final video.
quickPrompts.zh: 录一段这个浏览器操作，配 edge-tts 配音和字幕，剪成成片
